verdict.rationale: TrueLayer explicitly documents official SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java and .NET (truelayer-docs-11) that simplify API calls with typed interfaces and automate request signing (truelayer-docs-24), backed by a public GitHub signing library (truelayer-gh-1). Missing for 10: broader language coverage evidence, independent developer adoption signals (stars, community usage), and versioned changelog/release cadence proof.
